criteria.statement: DNSProjector accepts an optional ContinuityStatusReader dependency without changing existing constructor callers or requiring the dependency for normal projection.
When continuity status is absent or the active profile is full, service DNS projection preserves the existing primary endpoint derived from healthy RuntimeObservation state.
When continuity status is degraded or emergency, service DNS projection emits the service record using the ActiveWorkerPubKey worker RuntimeTarget.PublicBaseURL.
When continuity status is offline, service DNS projection omits the service record.
